_enabled: Master toggle. If false, the item remains craftable but cannot be used.
_minimumRange: Minimum cave length in blocks. Range 8-256.
_maximumRange: Maximum cave length in blocks. Range 8-256.
_torchSpacing: Approximate blocks between torch placements along the cave. Range 4-64.
_blocksPerTick: Maximum blocks removed per server tick while excavating. Range 1-2000.
_minHorizontalRadius: Smallest horizontal radius of the tunnel in blocks; the tunnel is about twice this wide. Range 1.0-16.0.
_maxHorizontalRadius: Largest horizontal radius of the tunnel in blocks. Range 1.0-16.0.
_minVerticalRadius: Smallest vertical radius of the tunnel in blocks; the tunnel is about twice this tall. Range 1.0-16.0.
_maxVerticalRadius: Largest vertical radius of the tunnel in blocks. Range 1.0-16.0.
_maxVerticalDrift: How far above or below its starting height the cave may wander, in blocks. 0 keeps it level. Range 0-64.
_maxTurnDegrees: Sharpest turn the cave may take per block, in degrees. Higher is windier; 0 is a straight tunnel. Range 0-90.
_maxActiveCaves: Maximum number of caves carving at once across the whole server. Range 1-64.
_blacklist: Blocks the Miner's Dream will never carve, even if they're in the #miners_dream:carvable tag. Block ids like "minecraft:obsidian" or tags like "#minecraft:logs". Datapacks can also use the #miners_dream:uncarvable tag.
